The difference

Two ways we work.

Both routes lead to a company that can execute across Asia. They differ in where the idea starts and how much we build alongside you.

Accelerator
We back founders.

You bring the company and the commercial foundation. We bring capital, compute and market access for six months.

Venture Studio
We build with founders.

We start from a thesis and build the company alongside you — entity, product, first customers and team.

How the studio works

Thesis to launch.

01

Thesis

We identify where AI changes the economics of a sector in these markets, and what has to be true for a company to win there.

02

Build

Prototype on VHA compute, tested against real operators before a company exists.

03

Incorporate

Founding team, entity, cap table and jurisdiction — structured for the markets the company will sell into.

04

Scale

First customers through the APAC Sandbox, then into the accelerator cohort and the raise.
